kyc.introBody: The Financial Regulatory Authority requires a quick identity check before you can buy a policy online. It takes about two minutes.

kyc.introStep2: Check the details we read from it
kyc.introStep3: Take a quick selfie to match your face
kyc.introPrivacy: Your data is encrypted and used only to verify your identity.
kyc.idHint: Place your ID inside the frame, in good light, with no glare.

kyc.checkPhoto: Make sure all text is sharp and readable.
kyc.reviewBody: We read these from your ID. Fix anything that's wrong before you continue.

kyc.selfieBody: Position your face in the oval and follow the prompts.
kyc.matching: Matching your face to your ID

kyc.faceUnlockHint: You can turn this off in settings.
